title: The Eiffel Tower Changes Size
short_teaser: A famous landmark moves more than you might expect.
story: Because metal expands when heated, the Eiffel Tower can become taller during warm weather. Temperature changes cause the structure to expand and contract. A famous landmark moves more than you might expect. Curiosity changes an ordinary fact into an invitation. Instead of stopping at what happened, it asks what else might be true, what assumptions may be incomplete, and what becomes visible when we look again. The lasting importance is simple: even things that appear permanent are constantly changing.
impact: Even things that appear permanent are constantly changing. Curiosity loosens the grip of assumptions and creates room for better questions. This matters because the lesson is transferable. It can help someone recognize a pattern, make a more thoughtful choice, or see possibility where they previously saw only a problem.
spark_application: What small changes are happening around you that you might not notice? Write three questions about something you have been assuming is fixed. Choose the question that opens the most possibility. Afterward, save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
